decision_conditions:
Condition : 1 - The proposed change of use from A1 (Retail) to A3 (Restaurant)
Incorporating a 'takeaway facility' would be likely to result in harm to neighbours' living conditions through increased noise and disturbance  created by the coming and going of patrons. It therefore fails to achieve an acceptable relationship with the surrounding area and is considered to be contrary to Adopted Unitary Development Plan policies ENV-B.1.1 (All New Development) and S.1.3 (Non retail uses in secondary frontages). 

Due to the location of the proposed restaurant and takeaway facility at the site and the inability to provide any off-street parking, conditions prejudicial to the free flow of traffic would be likely to result, which is considered to be contrary to Adopted UDP policies T.1.4 (Car and Cycle Parking and Servicing Facilities for Developments) and T.4.1 (Traffic Implications of New Development) of the London Borough of Hounslow Unitary Development Plan.
